title: IISc Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 05 Program Assistant Posts
description: The Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of 05 Program Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in M.Com, MBA, or MCA can use this chance and apply for the IISc Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
